items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My daughter Anahid just called me and told me about the sale of the horse

ctx.x: That’s probably it, isn’t it, that the parents of today’s generation, did not – at least your children and my children had the opportunity to be exposed to the music, because even if they didn’t . . .
My daughter Anahid just called me and told me about the sale of the horse that we [?] . . .
You have to talk about your horse.
